title: C00lclan
script:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

-- ciel qui devient bizarre
spawn(function()
    while true do
        wait(2)
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(0,255), math.random(0,255), math.random(0,255))
    end
end)

-- messages drama
spawn(function()
    local msgs = {
        "🚨 ERREUR SYSTÈME...",
        "🌍 Simulation instable...",
        "👁️ Quelqu’un te regarde...",
        "⚠️ Réalité en train de bug..."
    }
    while true do
        wait(3)
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage", {
            Text = msgs[math.random(1,#msgs)],
            Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0),
            Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        })
    end
end)

-- caméra qui tremble
spawn(function()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    while true do
        wait(0.1)
        cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(
            math.random(-1,1)/10,
            math.random(-1,1)/10,
            0
        )
    end
end)
